def backup_db(db_path, directory_path, custom_prefix="backup"):
    """ Backs up a database to a directory. """

    # Get the current time
    now = datetime.now()

    # Get the current date and time
    current_date_time = now.strftime("%Y-%m-%d_%H-%M-%S")

    # Get the filename to use
    filename = f"{custom_prefix}{current_date_time}.db"

    # Copy the database to the destination
    shutil.copyfile(db_path, os.path.join(directory_path, filename))
